newsitem.title: DUBAI: Six, 12 mth Saudi interbank deposits edge lower.
newsitem.headline: Six, 12 mth Saudi interbank deposits edge lower.

text.p: Longer-dated Saudi riyal interbank deposits softened in the week to Thursday, but shorter-dated funds remained steady at previous levels, dealers said.
"At the beginning of the week riyal deposits softened behind the U.S. rates, otherwise it was quiet," a dealer said.
One- and three-month deposits were flat at 5-7/16, 5/16 percent, 5-9/16, 7/16 respectively. Six- and 12- month funds were softer at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent and 5-13/16, 11/16 percent.
The spot Saudi riyal was stable on the dollar at 3.7503/7.
